why: A gritty scrub loosens dead, flaky surface cells and helps reduce callus buildup. Moisturizing ingredients leave the skin softer after exfoliation.
含颗粒的磨砂膏会松动干燥脱屑的表面死亡细胞，并帮助减轻老茧；保湿成分让去角质后的皮肤更柔软。
lock: scrub = exfoliate flakes and soften calluses.
磨砂膏 = 去除皮屑并软化老茧。

why: Artificial gel products cure when photoinitiators absorb ultraviolet energy. UV and LED gel lamps deliver selected ultraviolet wavelengths.
人工凝胶产品中的光引发剂吸收 ultraviolet（紫外线）能量后固化；UV 灯和 LED 凝胶灯都会提供特定紫外线波长。
lock: gel curing uses ultraviolet energy.
凝胶固化使用紫外线能量。
refs: Light-Cured Gels - UV and LED Lamps

why: A foot soak is made for pedicure bath water. It cleans, deodorizes, and softens feet without exposing skin to surface disinfectant.
foot soak（足浴浸泡剂）专为足浴水配制，可清洁、除味并软化足部，不会让皮肤接触表面消毒剂。
lock: pedicure bath = foot soak product.
足浴水 = 加入足浴浸泡剂。

why: Dehydrator temporarily removes moisture and oil from the nail plate. Primer follows on the clean surface to improve product attachment.
dehydrator（干燥剂）暂时去除甲板上的水分和油脂；随后在清洁表面使用底剂，以提高产品附着力。
lock: enhancement prep: dehydrator before primer.
增强甲准备顺序：先干燥剂，后底剂。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Nail Dehydrators and Primers

why: Filing from each side toward the center reduces stress on a thin natural nail. A back-and-forth sawing motion can split fragile layers.
从左右两侧分别向中心锉，可减少薄天然指甲承受的压力；来回拉锯式锉磨可能使脆弱甲层裂开。
lock: fragile nail: each side toward center.
脆弱指甲：两侧分别向中心锉。

why: Disposable implements are porous or otherwise unsuitable for complete disinfection. Reusing them can transfer germs from one client to another.
一次性器械具有多孔性，或因其他原因无法彻底消毒；重复使用可能把微生物从一位客户传给另一位。
lock: cannot disinfect safely = discard after use.
无法安全消毒 = 使用后丢弃。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Single-Use Items

why: Warm paraffin coats the skin and slows moisture loss. The retained warmth increases local circulation and makes dry skin feel softer.
温热石蜡包覆皮肤并减缓水分流失；保留的热量会促进局部循环，使干燥皮肤感觉更柔软。
lock: paraffin = trapped moisture plus gentle warmth.
石蜡护理 = 锁住水分并提供温热。

why: The well is the recessed area of a nail tip that contacts the natural nail. Its position stop guides correct alignment.
well（甲片贴合区）是甲片上与天然指甲接触的凹陷部分，其中的定位止点用于引导正确对齐。
lock: tip well = contact and alignment area.
甲片 well = 接触和对齐区域。
refs: Nail Tips and Forms - Nail Tip Anatomy

why: An abrasive file removes length and shapes the free edge that extends beyond the fingertip. It should not be used on living nail-bed tissue.
指甲锉用于缩短并塑造超过指尖的 free edge（游离缘），不应用于活体甲床组织。
lock: abrasive file works on the free edge.
指甲锉作用于游离缘。

why: A bit spinning too fast creates excess friction heat. Use the lowest effective speed, light pressure, and continuous movement.
磨头转速过高会产生过多摩擦热。应使用能有效工作的最低转速、轻压力，并持续移动。
lock: high RPM plus friction = excess heat.
高转速加摩擦 = 过热。
refs: Electric Filing - RPM Speed and Safe Use

why: Warm paraffin holds heat around the hands and reduces moisture loss. This combination comforts cold hands and softens dry skin.
温热石蜡可在手部周围保温并减少水分流失，因此能舒缓手部冰凉并软化干燥皮肤。
lock: cold, dry hands = warm paraffin treatment.
手部冰凉干燥 = 温热石蜡护理。

why: Massage increases circulation. Severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure is a contraindication, so the client needs medical guidance before massage.
按摩会促进血液循环。严重或未受控制的高血压属于禁忌，因此按摩前需要医疗人员指导。
lock: uncontrolled high blood pressure = medical clearance before massage.
未受控制的高血压 = 按摩前取得医疗许可。

why: A dehydrator removes surface moisture and oil before liquid-and-powder application. Cleaner contact helps reduce lifting and improves attachment.
dehydrator（干燥剂）在液体与粉末产品施工前去除表面水分和油脂；更清洁的接触可减少起翘并提高附着。
lock: dehydrator prepares a clean, dry plate.
干燥剂把甲板处理得清洁、干燥。

why: Reusable forms are durable aluminum or plastic guides placed under the free edge. They can be cleaned and disinfected between clients.
可重复使用的甲模是放在游离缘下方的耐用铝制或塑料导向工具，可在客户之间清洁和消毒。
lock: reusable forms = aluminum or plastic.
可重复使用的甲模 = 铝制或塑料。
refs: Nail Tips and Forms - Nail Forms

why: Base coat creates an even foundation and improves colored polish attachment. It can also help protect the natural plate from staining.
base coat（底油）形成均匀基础，并提高彩色指甲油的附着力，也能帮助保护天然甲板免受染色。
lock: polish order: base coat before color.
指甲油顺序：先底油，再彩色指甲油。

why: A clean nail brush removes loose debris from beneath the free edge without scraping living tissue. Brush gently and rinse away residue.
清洁的指甲刷可清除游离缘下方松散碎屑，不会刮伤活体组织；应轻柔刷洗并冲净残留。
lock: under free edge: clean gently with a nail brush.
游离缘下方：用指甲刷轻柔清洁。

why: Effleurage keeps the hands in contact while using slow, rhythmic strokes. The predictable gliding movement is calming and relaxing.
effleurage（轻抚法）让双手保持接触，并使用缓慢、有节奏的抚摸；稳定的滑行动作可使人平静放松。
lock: effleurage = slow, rhythmic, gliding strokes.
effleurage = 缓慢、有节奏的滑行轻抚。

why: A metal pusher has a hard reusable surface, so it must be cleaned and disinfected before each client and after every service.
金属推皮棒表面坚硬且可重复使用，因此每位客户服务前和每次服务后都必须清洁并消毒。
lock: reusable metal pusher = clean and disinfect every service.
可重复使用的金属推皮棒 = 每次服务都清洁消毒。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Reusable Items

why: A client card records health information, preferences, products, dates, and service results. Reviewing it supports safe, consistent future services.
客户档案卡记录健康信息、偏好、产品、日期和服务结果；查看记录有助于以后提供安全一致的服务。
lock: client card = history for planning successful services.
客户档案卡 = 规划成功服务所需的历史记录。
refs: Manicuring - Client Consultation and Service Record

why: Primer improves attachment between a prepared nail plate and gel when the product system requires it. Apply only the amount directed by the manufacturer.
产品系统要求时，primer（底剂）可提高处理好的甲板与凝胶之间的附着力；用量应严格遵循制造商说明。
lock: primer = bonding aid used as directed.
primer = 按说明使用的附着辅助产品。
